payload.summary: Two live-monitor scripts cannot use the shared entrypoint helper because the monitor workflow sparse-checks-out only those two files
payload.detail: Add scripts/lib/is-entrypoint.mjs to the sparse-checkout list in .github/workflows/live-domain-monitor.yml, then convert check-live-deployment-freshness.mjs and check-live-search-results.mjs and remove them from ALLOWED_RAW in tests/script-entrypoint-guard.test.ts. Why: they keep the raw file:// comparison, which is correct on Linux CI but would silently no-op if ever run on Windows. Context: converting them in PR 3507 would have broken the live monitor (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND), so it was reverted and allow-listed. Owner: assistant. Confidence: medium; low urgency because they run on Linux only.
